title_zh: HPV DNA 整合与宫颈上皮内瘤变 2 (CIN2) 的持续或进展相关。
source_body_en: OBJECTIVE(S): To determine whether identical HPV-human DNA integrations in cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 (CIN2) lesions are retained during progression to squamous cervical carcinoma (SCC) and whether such integrations can predict lesion persistence or progression. METHODS: Longitudinal cervical samples were analyzed using multiplexed DNA hybridization-capture targeting 225 HPV types, followed by short-read sequencing to identify HPV-human DNA integration junctions. Integration events were evaluated in (i) serial samples from CIN lesions that progressed to SCC and (ii) a baseline cohort of 23 patients with incident CIN2. Clinical outcomes (regression vs persistence/progression) were compared by integration status using Fisher's Exact Test and multivariable Bayesian logistic regression to estimate effect sizes in the setting of small sample size. RESULTS: Identical HPV-human DNA integrations were preserved across serial samples in seven CIN lesions that progressed to SCC, supporting their biological relevance in carcinogenesis. In the CIN2 cohort, no integrations were detected in any of the 12 patients whose lesions regressed, whereas integrations were present in four of eleven patients whose lesions persisted or progressed (p=0.04). Bayesian logistic regression estimated a 22-fold higher odds of persistence/progression when integration was detected at baseline CIN2 diagnosis. HPV16 positivity was also associated with persistence/progression, with a smaller estimated effect size (9.4-fold higher odds), consistent with prior epidemiologic observations. CONCLUSION(S): HPV DNA integrations were associated with CIN2 persistence and progression, and identical integrations were retained during evolution to SCC. Integration analysis at CIN2 diagnosis may identify lesions at highest risk for progression, providing a biomarker to refine clinical management and reduce unnecessary excisional procedures.
abstract_zh: 目的:确定 2 级宫颈上皮内瘤变 (CIN2) 病变中相同的 HPV-人类 DNA 整合在进展为鳞状宫颈癌 (SCC) 的过程中是否保留,以及此类整合是否可以预测病变持续或进展。方法:使用针对 225 种 HPV 类型的多重 DNA 杂交捕获分析纵向宫颈样本,然后进行短读长测序以识别 HPV-人类 DNA 整合连接点。在 (i) 进展为 SCC 的 CIN 病变的连续样本和 (ii) 23 名发生 CIN2 的患者的基线 队列研究 中评估整合事件。使用 Fisher 精确检验和多变量贝叶斯逻辑回归通过积分状态比较临床结果(回归与持续/进展),以估计小样本量设置中的效应大小。结果:七个进展为鳞状细胞癌的 CIN 病变的系列样本中保留了相同的 HPV-人类 DNA 整合,支持了它们在致癌过程中的生物学相关性。在 CIN2 队列研究 中,12 名病变消退的患者中均未检测到整合,而 11 名病变持续或进展的患者中有 4 名存在整合(p=0.04)。当在基线 CIN2 诊断 检测到整合时,贝叶斯逻辑回归估计持续/进展的几率高出 22 倍。HPV16 阳性也与持续/进展相关,估计效应较小(几率高 9.4 倍),与之前的流行病学观察结果一致。结论:HPV DNA 整合与 CIN2 持续存在和进展相关,并且在 进化 至 SCC 期间保留了相同的整合。CIN2 诊断 的整合分析可以识别进展风险最高的病变,从而提供生物标志物来完善临床管理并减少不必要的切除手术。

title: Assessing resource allocation and exploring measures to promote human papillomavirus vaccination in Beijing, China
abstract: This study aimed to comprehensively assess the availability and resource allocation of HPV vaccination services in Beijing, and to identify effective strategies for improving public vaccine acceptance and uptake. An ecological study was conducted across 499 vaccination clinics in Beijing in 2024. A structured questionnaire was administered to collect data on HPV vaccination service provision at each vaccination clinic. Nearest neighbor analysis, kernel density analysis, hot-spot analysis, and the resource-utilization efficiency matrix were applied to assess the allocation and utilization of vaccination resources. A negative binomial regression model was employed to estimate the incidence rate ratio (IRR) for HPV vaccination. In Beijing, 39.28% of health-care facilities and 93.59% of vaccination clinics provided HPV vaccination services. Among these vaccination clinics, 79.87% were based in primary health-care facilities, while only 4.07% were adult vaccination clinics located in secondary or tertiary hospitals. Mean weekly service hours and staffing were lower in immunization clinics (8 hours, 10 staff) than in adult clinics (27 hours, 18 staff). Electronic queuing systems (IRR = 1.45, 95% CI: 1.21–1.73), offline vaccination education (IRR = 1.43, 95% CI: 1.07–1.92), and ≥4 parental classes monthly (IRR = 2.93, 95% CI: 1.29–6.65) were significantly associated with higher HPV vaccination coverage. To alleviate shortages of HPV vaccination resources at routine immunization clinics and given the stronger service capacity of current adult vaccination clinics, pilot expansion at selected secondary and tertiary facilities may be warranted, pending formal cost-effectiveness evaluation. Initiatives such as conducting parental education and establishing electronic queuing systems were associated with higher vaccination doses.

title_zh: 评估资源配置并探索在中国北京推广人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗接种的措施
source_body_en: This study aimed to comprehensively assess the availability and resource allocation of HPV vaccination services in Beijing, and to identify effective strategies for improving public vaccine acceptance and uptake. An ecological study was conducted across 499 vaccination clinics in Beijing in 2024. A structured questionnaire was administered to collect data on HPV vaccination service provision at each vaccination clinic. Nearest neighbor analysis, kernel density analysis, hot-spot analysis, and the resource-utilization efficiency matrix were applied to assess the allocation and utilization of vaccination resources. A negative binomial regression model was employed to estimate the incidence rate ratio (IRR) for HPV vaccination. In Beijing, 39.28% of health-care facilities and 93.59% of vaccination clinics provided HPV vaccination services. Among these vaccination clinics, 79.87% were based in primary health-care facilities, while only 4.07% were adult vaccination clinics located in secondary or tertiary hospitals. Mean weekly service hours and staffing were lower in immunization clinics (8 hours, 10 staff) than in adult clinics (27 hours, 18 staff). Electronic queuing systems (IRR = 1.45, 95% CI: 1.21–1.73), offline vaccination education (IRR = 1.43, 95% CI: 1.07–1.92), and ≥4 parental classes monthly (IRR = 2.93, 95% CI: 1.29–6.65) were significantly associated with higher HPV vaccination coverage. To alleviate shortages of HPV vaccination resources at routine immunization clinics and given the stronger service capacity of current adult vaccination clinics, pilot expansion at selected secondary and tertiary facilities may be warranted, pending formal cost-effectiveness evaluation. Initiatives such as conducting parental education and establishing electronic queuing systems were associated with higher vaccination doses.

title: The assembly pathway for human papillomavirus L1 capsid protein is encoded in electrostatic interactions.
abstract: Human papillomavirus L1 protein spontaneously folds and assembles into 60 nm virus-like particles (VLP), with T = 7d icosahedral symmetry at high salt concentrations but not in low salt. Rapid increase from low to high salt during the assembly process gives poor-quality VLPs, while slowly increasing salt, over as many as 48 h, gives rise to high-quality VLPs. Insight into this behavior is drawn from a computational model based on the cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structure of the human papillomavirus Type 16 VLP. Electrostatic potential energy barriers were calculated using the linearized Poisson-Boltzmann equation. After initial, rapid oligomerization of monomers into symmetrical pentamers (capsomeres), these units form pairwise interactions in energetic order, lowest barrier first. But at high salt concentrations, the energetic barriers are more or less equal and irregular particles form, both in simulation and in experiments. The interaction interfaces were modified by mutation to favor the smaller, 30 nm T = 1 icosahedral symmetry and disfavor T = 7d symmetry. The results were smaller particles. By carefully controlling ionic strength, and/or by mutating interface residues by design, it is possible to make high quality, highly immunogenic VLPs directly from unpurified bacterial lysate, without requiring the use of a disassembly/reassembly step.
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the assembly pathway of human papillomavirus (HPV) L1 capsid protein, focusing on how salt concentration influences the formation of virus-like particles (VLPs) with specific icosahedral symmetries. The research highlights that rapid salt increases lead to poor-quality VLPs, while slow increases over 48 hours produce high-quality ones. Computational modeling based on cryo-EM data of HPV16 VLPs was used to calculate electrostatic potential energy barriers, and mutations were introduced to favor T = 1 symmetry over T = 7d. The results suggest that careful control of ionic strength and targeted mutations can generate immunogenic VLPs directly from bacterial lysates, eliminating the need for disassembly/reassembly steps. These findings have implications for improving vaccine production and diagnostic methods. However, the study's reliance on computational models and limited experimental validation introduces some limitations, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

title: Undergraduate nursing students’ perceptions of human papillomavirus and its prevention: a qualitative study guided by the Health Belief Model
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is a significant public health concern and the leading cause of cervical cancer as well as several other malignancies. Despite its importance, there is limited qualitative evidence examining nursing students’ perceptions of HPV and its prevention in Saudi Arabia. This study sought to investigate undergraduate nursing students’ perceptions of HPV and its prevention using the Health Belief Model (HBM) as a theoretical framework. This descriptive qualitative study utilized six focus group discussions (FGDs) involving 36 eligible undergraduate nursing students from the University of Bisha, Saudi Arabia. Participants were recruited through purposive sampling. Thematic analysis was conducted based on the HBM, employing its six constructs as predefined overarching analytic domains, while specific subthemes were developed inductively from participants’ accounts. The six deductive themes, perceived susceptibility, perceived severity, perceived benefits, perceived barriers, cues to action, and self-efficacy, correspond to the HBM constructs. Inductively developed subthemes included inadequate understanding of HPV, low perceived personal susceptibility, misconceptions about vaccination safety and transmission, stigma, and challenges in discussing sensitive sexual health issues. Participants also described perceived institutional and educational influences on communication preparedness, professional relevance, and HPV knowledge. These findings do not demonstrate the efficacy of specific teaching methods but highlight educational needs within this sample. Undergraduate nursing students identified knowledge gaps, misunderstandings, stigma, societal challenges, and a lack of confidence when discussing HPV prevention. The findings emphasize the necessity of providing evidence-based and culturally sensitive education on HPV transmission, screening, vaccination, reproductive health issues, stigma, and communication skills. These needs could be met through case-based learning, role-playing, simulation and communication training, but the present study did not evaluate their effectiveness and further research is needed.

title: HPV-Associated oropharyngeal cancer: Changes in epidemiological profile and prognostic implications
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma has altered the epidemiology and prognostic interpretation of head and neck cancer. This narrative critical review examines changes in incidence and demographic distribution, the validity of HPV-related tumor classification, and the implications of viral status for survival and treatment decisions. Literature indexed in PubMed/MEDLINE through 2026 was examined alongside professional guidelines and institutional cancer-prevention resources. Population-based studies document a marked increase in HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer in several high-income settings, with an increasingly important burden among older men, while estimates remain heterogeneous across regions. HPV-positive tumors generally have more favorable survival than HPV-negative tumors, but smoking exposure, disease extent, and discordance between p16 and HPV-specific tests modify this advantage. Staging revisions acknowledge the distinct disease phenotype, including refinements introduced in 2026. Randomized trials demonstrate that favorable prognosis cannot justify indiscriminate treatment reduction, although selected postoperative de-intensification approaches are promising. Vaccination reduces vaccine-type oral HPV infection, whereas an effect on incident oropharyngeal cancer will require longer observation. Prognostic assessment should integrate viral attribution, anatomical stage, patient characteristics, treatment quality, and long-term functional outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the evolving epidemiological profile of HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer, emphasizing its impact on head and neck cancer demographics and prognosis. The evidence highlights the increasing incidence among older men in high-income regions and the heterogeneity of estimates globally. HPV-positive tumors show better survival outcomes, but factors like smoking, disease stage, and test discordance can alter this. Staging revisions reflect the distinct disease phenotype. title: Beyond Normal Cytology: Clinical Significance of HPV 16/18 Positivity in a High-Risk Adolescent — A Case Report
abstract: Background: High-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection is a major etiological factor for cervical cancer. Appropriate risk-based management is essential, especially in young patients with normal cytology but positive HR-HPV test results. Case presentation: A 17-year old single female with a history of commercial sex work presented with recurrent vaginal discharge and previously treated genital warts. She reported having multiple sexual partners with inconsistent condom use after leaving sex work. Gynecological examination revealed a reddish cervix with whitish discharge, while Pap smear results were normal. However, HR HPV testing was positive. Colposcopic evaluation showed acetowhite changes at the 11–12 o’clock position with negative iodine uptake on Lugol’s test. A loop electrosurgical excision procedure (LEEP) biopsy was performed, and histopathological results were pending. Discussion: According to the 2019 ASCCP risk-based guidelines, patients with positive result of HR-HPV and normal cytology generally have a low immediate risk of CIN3+and may be managed with surveillance. However, the presence of high-risk HPV types, particularly HPV 16/18, justifies early colposcopic evaluation despite normal cytology. The Indonesian Gynecologic Oncology (Himpunan Onkologi Ginekologi Indonesia/HOGI) guidelines similarly recommend colposcopy or visual inspection with acetic acid (VIA) in HRHPV-positive patients, followed by appropriate intervention if lesions are detected. Conclusions: This case highlights the importance of individualized, risk-based management in HR-HPV-positive patients. Early colposcopic assessment may be warranted even with normal cytology, particularly in high-risk populations, to ensure timely detection and treatment of precancerous lesions.

title_zh: 超越正常细胞学:高危青少年 HPV 16/18 阳性的临床意义 — 病例报告
source_body_en: Background: High-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection is a major etiological factor for cervical cancer. Appropriate risk-based management is essential, especially in young patients with normal cytology but positive HR-HPV test results. Case presentation: A 17-year old single female with a history of commercial sex work presented with recurrent vaginal discharge and previously treated genital warts. She reported having multiple sexual partners with inconsistent condom use after leaving sex work. Gynecological examination revealed a reddish cervix with whitish discharge, while Pap smear results were normal. However, HR HPV testing was positive. Colposcopic evaluation showed acetowhite changes at the 11–12 o’clock position with negative iodine uptake on Lugol’s test. A loop electrosurgical excision procedure (LEEP) biopsy was performed, and histopathological results were pending. Discussion: According to the 2019 ASCCP risk-based guidelines, patients with positive result of HR-HPV and normal cytology generally have a low immediate risk of CIN3+and may be managed with surveillance. However, the presence of high-risk HPV types, particularly HPV 16/18, justifies early colposcopic evaluation despite normal cytology. The Indonesian Gynecologic Oncology (Himpunan Onkologi Ginekologi Indonesia/HOGI) guidelines similarly recommend colposcopy or visual inspection with acetic acid (VIA) in HRHPV-positive patients, followed by appropriate intervention if lesions are detected. Conclusions: This case highlights the importance of individualized, risk-based management in HR-HPV-positive patients. Early colposcopic assessment may be warranted even with normal cytology, particularly in high-risk populations, to ensure timely detection and treatment of precancerous lesions.

title: 1064 PapillomaVax: a compact 9-mer universal polyepitope mRNA vaccine spanning HPV16 E2, E5, E6, and E7 drives simultaneous multi-specific CD8 + T cell priming in primary human PBMCs
abstract: Background Therapeutic HPV vaccination requires broad, multi-specific CD8 + CTL responses against constitutively expressed viral oncoproteins to sustain tumor control and limit immune escape through selective antigen downregulation, documented in immune-edited HPV-positive tumors. The 27-mer flanking sequence format is commonly used but its coding burden constrains multi-protein coverage. We systematically quantified the immunological cost of a compact 9-mer format and applied the resulting design principles to a 16-epitope HPV16-specific polyepitope mRNA encoding known immunogenic epitopes from E2, E5, E6, and E7 proteins.Methods Four HLA-A02:01-restricted mRNA constructs were compared: single-9mer, multi-9mer, single-27mer, and multi-27mer, encoding the immunodominant influenza M1 epitope GILGFVFTL alongside eight subdominant filler epitopes in the multi-epitope conditions. Epitope-specific CD8 + T cell responses were quantified by MHC-I tetramer staining following in vitro priming with mRNA-electroporated autologous dendritic cells, with orthogonal readouts from 24-hour K562/Jurkat NFAT-luciferase TCR reporter assays and IFNγ ELISpot. A 16-epitope HPV16 9-mer polyepitope mRNA encoding validated multi HLA-restricted CTL epitopes from E2, E5, E6, and E7, HLA binding, and published human CTL reactivity was evaluated for multi-specific priming in HLA-A02:01+ primary human PBMCs by MHC-I tetramer staining, Jurkat NFAT-luciferase TCR reporter activation, and IFNγ ELISpot.Results Single-epitope encoding in 27-mer format modestly enhanced GILGFVFTL-tetramer + frequency over 9-mer (6.29% versus 4.72%). In the multi-epitope context, the 9-mer format imposed a ~50% reduction relative to the 27-mer ceiling (6.37% versus 3.36%), with the single-epitope 9-mer intermediate (4.72%), confirming inter-epitope competition as the dominant suppressive mechanism in compact constructs. TCR reporter activation mirrored this hierarchy: multi-27mer drove ~50-fold above-control activation versus ~25-fold for multi-9mer (p < 0.001). Despite the competition penalty inherent to the compact format, the 16-epitope universal PapillomaVax mRNA drove detectable and simultaneous CD8+ T cell responses against both E6 and E7 specificities in primary HLA-A*02:01+ PBMCs: E6-tetramer+ 9.49% and E7-tetramer+ 7.96% following PapillomaVax mRNA priming versus 0.42% and 0.11% in unstimulated controls, compared to 6.34% and 5.35% with cognate peptide stimulation. IFNγ ELISpot confirmed antigen-specific responses for PapillomaVax mRNA versus ~25 SFCs/5×105 for unstimulated controls (p < 0.001), exceeding both E7 peptide (~500 SFCs/5×105, p < 0.01) and E6 peptide (~550 SFCs/5×105, p < 0.001) restimulation conditions. Jurkat NFAT-luciferase TCR reporter activation confirmed MHC-I-restricted antigen presentation of both E6 (TIHDIILECV; 39-fold above control, p < 0.001) and E7 (YMLDLQPET; 24-fold above control, p < 0.001) specificities.Conclusions The 9-mer polyepitope format enables simultaneous multi-protein CTL priming across HPV16 E2, E5, E6, and E7 at a quantified and acceptable per-epitope cost.Ethics Approval IRB approved and available on request.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估 HPV16 特异性多表位 mRNA 疫苗 的紧凑 9 聚体格式的免疫成本及其在原代人 PBMC 中驱动同时多特异性 CD8 + T 细胞启动的能力。这一背景强调了针对 HPV 癌蛋白的广泛、多特异性 CD8 + CTL 反应的需要,以控制 HPV 阳性肿瘤。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究比较了四种 HLA-A02:01 限制性 mRNA 构建体:单 9mer、多 9mer、单 27mer 和多 27mer,编码免疫显性流感 M1 表位以及多表位条件下的 8 个次显性填充表位。该研究是在来自 HLA-A02:01+ 供体的原代人类 PBMC 中进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 表位特异性 CD8 + T 细胞反应通过 MHC-I 四聚体染色进行定量,然后用 mRNA 电穿孔的自体树突状细胞进行体外引发,并使用 24 小时 K562/Jurkat NFAT-荧光素酶 TCR 报告基因测定和 IFNγ ELISpot 的正交读数。
elements_zh.main_results: 相对于单表位 9 聚体中间体的 27 聚体上限,9 聚体形式使 CD8 + T 细胞反应降低约 50%。尽管存在竞争惩罚,但 16 个表位通用 PapillomaVax mRNA 在原代 HLA-A*02:01+ PBMC 中驱动了针对 E6 和 E7 特异性的可检测且同步的 CD8+ T 细胞反应。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究得出的结论是,9 聚体多表位格式能够以量化且可接受的每个表位成本同时启动跨 HPV16 E2、E5、E6 和 E7 的多蛋白 CTL。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,9 聚体格式可用于开发紧凑的 HPV16 特异性多表位 mRNA 疫苗,它可以驱动同时多特异性 CD8 + T 细胞启动,这对于治疗 HPV 疫苗接种 和肿瘤控制可能具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究设计的局限性包括使用单一 HLA-A02:01 限制性构建体以及需要在更大、更多样化的人群中进行进一步验证。由于证据仅具有抽象性质,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 背景 治疗性 HPV 疫苗接种 需要针对组成型表达的病毒癌蛋白的广泛、多特异性 CD8 + CTL 反应,以维持肿瘤控制并通过选择性抗原下调来限制免疫逃逸,这在免疫编辑的 HPV 阳性肿瘤中已有记录。27 聚体侧翼序列格式很常用,但其编码负担限制了多蛋白覆盖。我们系统地量化了紧凑 9 聚体格式的免疫成本,并将所得设计原理应用于编码来自 E2、E5、E6 和 E7 蛋白的已知免疫原性表位的 16 表位 HPV16 特异性多表位 mRNA。方法比较了四种 HLA-A02:01 限制性 mRNA 构建体:单 9 聚体、多 9 聚体、单 27 聚体和多 27 聚体,编码在多表位条件下,免疫显性流感 M1 表位 GILGFVFTL 与八个次显性填充表位一起。表位特异性 CD8 + T 细胞反应通过 MHC-I 四聚体染色进行定量,然后用 mRNA 电穿孔的自体树突状细胞进行体外引发,并使用 24 小时 K562/Jurkat NFAT-荧光素酶 TCR 报告基因测定和 IFNγ ELISpot 的正交读数。16 表位 HPV16 9 聚体多表位 mRNA 编码验证了来自 E2、E5、E6 和 E7 的多个 HLA 限制性 CTL 表位、HLA 结合和已发表的人 CTL 反应性,通过 MHC-I 四聚体染色、Jurkat NFAT-荧光素酶 TCR 报告基因激活和 IFNγ 评估 HLA-A02:01+ 原代人 PBMC 中的多特异性引发ELISpot.结果 与 9 聚体相比,27 聚体格式的单表位编码适度增强了 GILGFVFTL-四聚体 + 频率(6.29% 对比 4.72%)。在多表位背景下,9聚体形式相对于27聚体上限减少了约50%(6.37%对3.36%),单表位9聚体中间体(4.72%),证实表位间竞争是紧凑构建体中的主要抑制机制。TCR 报告基因激活反映了这种层次结构:多 27mer 驱动的激活比对照高约 50 倍,而多 9mer 则高出约 25 倍(p < 0.001)。尽管紧凑格式固有的竞争惩罚,16表位通用 PapillomaVax mRNA 在原代 HLA-A*02:01+ PBMC 中驱动可检测到的同时针对 E6 和 E7 特异性的 CD8+ T 细胞反应:PapillomaVax mRNA 引发后 E6-四聚体+ 9.49% 和 E7-四聚体+ 7.96%,而 PapillomaVax mRNA 引发后为 0.42% 和未刺激对照为 0.11%,而同源肽刺激为 6.34% 和 5.35%。IFNγ ELISpot 证实了 PapillomaVax mRNA 的抗原特异性反应,与未刺激对照的~25 SFCs/5×105 相比(p < 0.001),超过了 E7 肽(~500 SFCs/5×105,p < 0.01)和 E6 肽(~550 SFCs/5×105,p < 0.001)再刺激条件。Jurkat NFAT-荧光素酶 TCR 报告基因激活证实了 E6(TIHDIILECV;比对照高 39 倍,p < 0.001)和 E7(YMLDLQPET;比对照高 24 倍,p < 0.001)特异性的 MHC-I 限制性抗原呈递。结论 9 聚体多表位格式能够同时启动跨 HPV16 E2、E5、 E6 和 E7 以量化且可接受的每个表位成本。伦理审批 IRB 批准并可根据要求提供。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估 HPV16 特异性多表位 mRNA 疫苗 的紧凑 9 聚体格式的免疫成本及其在原代人 PBMC 中驱动同时多特异性 CD8 + T 细胞启动的能力。这一背景强调了针对 HPV 癌蛋白的广泛、多特异性 CD8 + CTL 反应的需要,以控制 HPV 阳性肿瘤。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究比较了四种 HLA-A02:01 限制性 mRNA 构建体:单 9mer、多 9mer、单 27mer 和多 27mer,编码免疫显性流感 M1 表位以及多表位条件下的 8 个次显性填充表位。该研究是在来自 HLA-A02:01+ 供体的原代人类 PBMC 中进行的。
analysis_zh.methods: 表位特异性 CD8 + T 细胞反应通过 MHC-I 四聚体染色进行定量,然后用 mRNA 电穿孔的自体树突状细胞进行体外引发,并使用 24 小时 K562/Jurkat NFAT-荧光素酶 TCR 报告基因测定和 IFNγ ELISpot 的正交读数。
analysis_zh.main_results: 相对于单表位 9 聚体中间体的 27 聚体上限,9 聚体形式使 CD8 + T 细胞反应降低约 50%。尽管存在竞争惩罚,但 16 个表位通用 PapillomaVax mRNA 在原代 HLA-A*02:01+ PBMC 中驱动了针对 E6 和 E7 特异性的可检测且同步的 CD8+ T 细胞反应。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究得出的结论是,9 聚体多表位格式能够以量化且可接受的每个表位成本同时启动跨 HPV16 E2、E5、E6 和 E7 的多蛋白 CTL。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,9 聚体格式可用于开发紧凑的 HPV16 特异性多表位 mRNA 疫苗,它可以驱动同时多特异性 CD8 + T 细胞启动,这对于治疗 HPV 疫苗接种 和肿瘤控制可能具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究设计的局限性包括使用单一 HLA-A02:01 限制性构建体以及需要在更大、更多样化的人群中进行进一步验证。由于证据仅具有抽象性质,证据强度中等。

title: High-Risk Human Papillomavirus Predominance and Genotypic Diversity among Women with Cervical Complaints in Bangladesh
abstract: Background Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the main cause of cervical cancer (CC) in Bangladesh. This study investigated HPV occurrence, circulating genotypes, and their phylogenetic relationships among Bangladeshi women with cervical complaints. It also characterized the complete genome, lineage, and mutations of an HPV45 strain from Bangladesh. Methods Cervical swabs from 102 women with cervical complaints were obtained at a tertiary-care hospital in Bangladesh. HPV was detected by PCR amplification using gene-specific primers. Among the HPV-positive samples, those showing strong PCR band intensity were selected for Sanger sequencing of the partial L1 gene. Complete genome sequencing of a representative HPV45 strain was sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq X Plus platform. Phylogenetic analyses were conducted using MAFFT, IQ-TREE2, and RAxML-NG. Mutational, structural, and protein stability analyses were performed using bioinformatic and structural modeling tools. Results HPV DNA was detected in 47.1% (48/102) of participants. Of the 36 samples selected for Sanger sequencing based on strong PCR band intensity, 21 were successfully sequenced. Genotyping of sequenced strains revealed a predominance of high-risk HPV genotypes (95.45%); HPV16 (68.18%) and HPV18 (13.63%). Phylogenetic analyses demonstrated genotype-specific clustering and close genetic relatedness to globally circulating strains. Complete genomic characterization of an HPV45 strain (HPV_MGH-TT01) revealed a 7,849-bp genome belonging to the A2 sublineage, with 98.0-99.9% nucleotide identity to global reference strains. Multiple amino acid substitutions were identified, particularly within the E2 protein, although structural analyses predicted only minor conformational alterations. Conclusions The predominance of high-risk HPV genotypes and the genomic characterization of HPV45 highlight the importance of large-scale genomic surveillance and expanded molecular screening for preventing CC in Bangladesh.
journal: Journal of Infection and Public Health

title_zh: 孟加拉国宫颈疾病女性的高风险 人乳头瘤病毒 优势和基因型多样性
source_body_en: Background Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the main cause of cervical cancer (CC) in Bangladesh. This study investigated HPV occurrence, circulating genotypes, and their phylogenetic relationships among Bangladeshi women with cervical complaints. It also characterized the complete genome, lineage, and mutations of an HPV45 strain from Bangladesh. Methods Cervical swabs from 102 women with cervical complaints were obtained at a tertiary-care hospital in Bangladesh. HPV was detected by PCR amplification using gene-specific primers. Among the HPV-positive samples, those showing strong PCR band intensity were selected for Sanger sequencing of the partial L1 gene. Complete genome sequencing of a representative HPV45 strain was sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq X Plus platform. Phylogenetic analyses were conducted using MAFFT, IQ-TREE2, and RAxML-NG. Mutational, structural, and protein stability analyses were performed using bioinformatic and structural modeling tools. Results HPV DNA was detected in 47.1% (48/102) of participants. Of the 36 samples selected for Sanger sequencing based on strong PCR band intensity, 21 were successfully sequenced. Genotyping of sequenced strains revealed a predominance of high-risk HPV genotypes (95.45%); HPV16 (68.18%) and HPV18 (13.63%). Phylogenetic analyses demonstrated genotype-specific clustering and close genetic relatedness to globally circulating strains. Complete genomic characterization of an HPV45 strain (HPV_MGH-TT01) revealed a 7,849-bp genome belonging to the A2 sublineage, with 98.0-99.9% nucleotide identity to global reference strains. Multiple amino acid substitutions were identified, particularly within the E2 protein, although structural analyses predicted only minor conformational alterations. Conclusions The predominance of high-risk HPV genotypes and the genomic characterization of HPV45 highlight the importance of large-scale genomic surveillance and expanded molecular screening for preventing CC in Bangladesh.
abstract_zh: 背景 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 是孟加拉国 宫颈癌 (CC) 的主要原因。本研究调查了患有宫颈疾病的孟加拉国女性中 HPV 的发生率、循环基因型及其系统发育关系。它还表征了来自孟加拉国的 HPV45 毒株的完整 基因组、谱系和 突变。方法 从孟加拉国一家三级医院采集了 102 名患有宫颈疾病的女性的宫颈拭子。使用基因特异性引物通过 PCR 扩增检测 HPV。在HPV阳性样本中,选择PCR条带强度较强的样本进行部分L1基因的Sanger测序。在 Illumina NovaSeq X Plus 平台上对代表性 HPV45 毒株进行完整的 基因组 测序。使用 MAFFT、IQ-TREE2 和 RAxML-NG 进行系统发育分析。使用生物信息学和结构建模工具进行突变、结构和蛋白质稳定性分析。结果 47.1% (48/102) 的参与者检测到 HPV DNA。基于PCR条带强度强,选择进行桑格测序的36个样本中,有21个样本成功测序。对测序菌株的基因分型显示,高危型HPV 基因型占主导地位(95.45%);HPV16(68.18%)和HPV18(13.63%)。系统发育分析证明了基因型特异性聚类以及与全球流行菌株的密切遗传相关性。HPV45 毒株 (HPV_MGH-TT01) 的完整基因组特征揭示了属于 A2 亚系的 7,849 bp 基因组,与全球参考毒株具有 98.0-99.9% 的核苷酸同一性。尽管结构分析预测只有较小的构象改变,但鉴定出多个氨基酸取代,特别是在 E2 蛋白内。结论 高危型HPV 基因型的优势和 HPV45 的基因组特征凸显了大规模 基因组监测 和扩大分子筛查对于孟加拉国预防 CC 的重要性。

title: Trends in Routine First-Dose Human Papillomavirus Vaccination Coverage in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan, Fiscal Years 2020–2025
abstract: Abstract Background In Japan, proactive recommendations for human papillomavirus vaccination were suspended in 2013 and resumed in fiscal year 2022 alongside a catch-up program, whose first-dose eligibility ended in fiscal year 2024. Coverage among subsequent routine-vaccination cohorts remains unclear. We described first-dose vaccination coverage in Wakayama Prefecture during fiscal years 2020–2025, focusing on grade-specific differences between 2024 and 2025. Methods This descriptive epidemiological study used aggregated administrative data. Age-specific first-dose counts were obtained from e-Stat for fiscal years 2020–2021 and the Wakayama Prefectural Government for 2022–2025. Denominators were age-specific female populations from the 2020 Population Census. Vaccination counts and population data were reconstructed by birth fiscal year using a published method. Annual and cumulative coverage were estimated for the 2004–2013 birth cohorts. Results Between fiscal years 2024 and 2025, annual coverage changed from 3.8% to 4.1% in sixth-grade elementary school students, 20.6% to 15.4% in first-year junior high school students, 2.2% to 7.7% in second-year junior high school students, 30.5% to 16.4% in third-year junior high school students, and 13.1% to 6.1% in first-year high school students. Cumulative coverage by the end of first-year high school was 46.5% and 49.9% for the 2008 and 2009 birth cohorts, respectively. The highest-coverage grade shifted from first-year high school to third-year junior high school. Conclusions The predominant timing of first-dose vaccination shifted toward younger grades during fiscal years 2020–2025. However, annual coverage in 2025 was lower than in 2024 among first- and third-year junior high school students and first-year high school students.

title_zh: 2020-2025 财年日本和歌山县常规首剂 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗接种 覆盖率趋势
source_body_en: Abstract Background In Japan, proactive recommendations for human papillomavirus vaccination were suspended in 2013 and resumed in fiscal year 2022 alongside a catch-up program, whose first-dose eligibility ended in fiscal year 2024. Coverage among subsequent routine-vaccination cohorts remains unclear. We described first-dose vaccination coverage in Wakayama Prefecture during fiscal years 2020–2025, focusing on grade-specific differences between 2024 and 2025. Methods This descriptive epidemiological study used aggregated administrative data. Age-specific first-dose counts were obtained from e-Stat for fiscal years 2020–2021 and the Wakayama Prefectural Government for 2022–2025. Denominators were age-specific female populations from the 2020 Population Census. Vaccination counts and population data were reconstructed by birth fiscal year using a published method. Annual and cumulative coverage were estimated for the 2004–2013 birth cohorts. Results Between fiscal years 2024 and 2025, annual coverage changed from 3.8% to 4.1% in sixth-grade elementary school students, 20.6% to 15.4% in first-year junior high school students, 2.2% to 7.7% in second-year junior high school students, 30.5% to 16.4% in third-year junior high school students, and 13.1% to 6.1% in first-year high school students. Cumulative coverage by the end of first-year high school was 46.5% and 49.9% for the 2008 and 2009 birth cohorts, respectively. The highest-coverage grade shifted from first-year high school to third-year junior high school. Conclusions The predominant timing of first-dose vaccination shifted toward younger grades during fiscal years 2020–2025. However, annual coverage in 2025 was lower than in 2024 among first- and third-year junior high school students and first-year high school students.

title: HUMAN PAPILLOMAVIRUS TYPE 16 AND 18 INFECTION ASSOCIATION WITH IL-38 GENE EXPRESSION IN IRAQI WOMEN WITH BREAST CANCER
abstract: Introduction: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is implicated in the pathogenesis of several malignancies, and its possible role in breast cancer remains under investigation. This study aimed to explore the relationship between HPV infection and breast cancer and to assess its effect on the expression of interleukin-38 (IL-38). Methodology: The study population consisted of 40 patients and 39 control participants. HPV detection was performed by ELISA technique, followed by PCR for confirmation, while gene expression analysis of IL-38 was carried out in a subset of seven patients using housekeeping gene normalization. Results: ELISA results showed no positive cases among patients, whereas five control samples were positive. In contrast, PCR analysis was performed on 10 patients and 3 controls, the results showed that 8 of the patient samples were positive for both HPV types 18 and 16, while the controls had one positive for only HPV-16 and another sample was positive for both HPV-16 and -18. Gene expression analysis revealed altered expression of IL-38 among patients compared with controls, with most samples showing increased fold change. Discussion: Overall, the results are consistent with the hypothesis of possible prior exposure or latent HPV infection and suggest that treatment-related immune suppression may warrant further investigation. Dysregulation of IL-38 expression may suggest an immune response in HPV-associated breast cancer. Further investigation into a larger sample size is necessary to fully understand the molecular relationship between HPV infection, cytokine regulation and breast cancer progression.

title: Association of classical sexually transmitted infections and genital mycoplasmas detection with high-risk human papillomavirus and cervical lesions among women undergoing cervical cancer screening in Ethiopia
abstract: Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) infection is the necessary cause of cervical cancer. A small proportion of HPV infections may progress to high-grade cervical lesions or cancer. Genital mycoplasma and sexually transmitted infections (STIs) may be associated with HPV persistence and progression. These detections or infections may also reduce the diagnostic accuracy of visual inspection-based screening by increasing local inflammation. In Ethiopia, there is still limited evidence on the association of STIs and genital mycoplasmas with hrHPV, cervical lesions, and visual inspection with acetic acid or Lugol’s iodine (VILI/VILI). This study assessed the prevalence of certain classical STIs and genital mycoplasma, their association with hrHPV infection, cervical lesions, and VIA/VILI outcomes among women undergoing HPV-based cervical cancer screening. Vaginal self-samples from 885 Ethiopian women were tested for 14 hrHPV types, C. trachomatis (CT), N. gonorrhoeae (NG), T. vaginalis (TV), and four genital mycoplasmas using real-time PCR. One hundred and fifty-six women who tested positive for hrHPV underwent VIA/VILI, and 116 women underwent histology examinations. Frequencies and percentages were used to summarize descriptive statistics of categorical variables. The prevalence estimates were provided with 95% confidence intervals (CIs), using the Wilson score method. Associations were assessed by the chi-square test and logistic regression analysis between the independent and outcome variables. A Firth-penalized multivariable logistic regression analysis was also used for histological results and independent variables. Among the study participants, 568 women (64.2%) had at least one sexually transmitted microbe (STM) (95% CI: 61–67). Classical STIs were detected in 4.3% (95% CI: 3.1–5.8), and genital mycoplasmas in 64% (95% CI: 60.7–67.1) of participants. parvum was the most frequently detected species. High-risk HPV infection was associated with genital mycoplasma detection (AOR = 1.7, 95% CI: 1.3–2.3, p = 0.001), C. trachomatis infection (AOR = 5.4, 95% CI: 1.4–21, p = 0.014), M. hominis detection (AOR = 2.0, 95% CI: 1.4-3.0, p = 0.001), and HIV infection (AOR = 3.2, 95% CI: 1.8–5.5, p < 0.001). CIN2 + lesions were associated with both hrHPV (AOR = 6.77, 95% CI: 1.2–75.4, P = 0.03) and HIV infection (AOR = 8.92, 95% CI: 1.5–72.2, P = 0.02). Neither STIs nor genital mycoplasma detection were associated with VIA/VILI outcomes. Classical STIs were low among the women included in the study. However, one out of five women were infected with hrHPV, and 64% of the women were harbored genital mycoplasma. HrHPV infection was associated with genital mycoplasma detection, C. trachomatis infection , M. hominis detection, and HIV infection. HrHPV and HIV infections were associated with CIN2 + lesions, whereas classical STIs and genital mycoplasma were not associated with cervical abnormalities. There was no association between STIs or the detection of genital mycoplasma and the outcomes of VIA/VILI. Overall, this study emphasizes the importance of considering HPV–HIV co-infections in cervical cancer prevention strategies.

title: 852 ABS005, a novel hydrogel, for treatment of high-grade cervical intraepithelial neoplasia
abstract: Background Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN 2/3) management relies on excisional or ablative procedures. 1 While effective, these interventions are associated with cervical stenosis,2 increased rates of preterm birth and miscarriage,3–5 and do not address the underlying human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, leading to persistence and recurrence. Absco Therapeutics has developed ABS005, a treatment for CIN2/3. ABS005 incorporates imiquimod, a TLR7 agonist used off-label for CIN2/3 with modest efficacy against both the lesion and HPV.6 However, topical formulations are limited by poor retention and washout.7 ABS005 is intended for direct intracervical injection, forming a depot for sustained, on-target imiquimod delivery. ABS005 is designed to eliminate CIN2/3 lesions and educate the immune system against HPV infection. This approach may preserve cervical integrity and future obstetric outcomes, providing women non-surgical treatment options.Methods The hydrogel properties and in vitro release profile of ABS005 were first characterized. To evaluate in vivo efficacy, single and multiple ABS005 treatments were assessed in a murine model of cervical cancer where HPV-positive Tal3 tumor cells are inoculated into C57BL/6 mouse flanks.8 9 Flow cytometry characterized the intratumoral response, profiling antigen presenting cells (CD80+ and 86+), dendritic cells (CD11c+), anti-tumor macrophage (F4/80+), cytotoxic T-cell (CD4+/CD8+) and NK-cell populations (CD45+/CD3-/CD49b+). Local-to-systemic therapeutic ratios were defined by comparing intratumoral and systemic drug pharmacokinetic profiles. Finally, we characterized the toxicokinetic profile of ABS005 following intracervical injection in canines.Results We formulated a polymer that solidifies into a gel at 34°C (±2°C) and provides sustained drug release over 48 hours in vitro and at least one week in vivo. In the murine model, both single and multiple treatments of ABS005 successfully halted tumor growth (figure 1) and stimulated an intratumoral immune profile consistent with imiquimod’s mechanism of action. Pharmacokinetic analysis revealed exceptional local retention, with intratumoral imiquimod concentrations exceeding systemic levels by 20,000-fold (figure 2). Furthermore, canine intracervical injections demonstrated that ABS005 was well tolerated, with a peak plasma Cmax of 19.4 ng/mL at 30 minutes post-treatment.Conclusions These data suggest that ABS005 can provide a sustained, controlled release of imiquimod to treat HPV-driven dysplasia while maintaining a favorable safety profile. analysis.summary_en: This study presents ABS005, a novel hydrogel designed for the treatment of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN 2/3) and HPV-driven dysplasia. The research highlights the limitations of current excisional or ablative procedures, which are associated with complications such as cervical stenosis, preterm birth, and miscarriage. ABS005 incorporates imiquimod, a TLR7 agonist, and is intended for direct intracervical injection to provide sustained drug release. In vitro and in vivo experiments demonstrated that ABS005 effectively halted tumor growth in a murine model and showed exceptional local retention of imiquimod, with concentrations exceeding systemic levels by 20,000-fold. Canine studies indicated that ABS005 was well tolerated. The authors interpret these findings as suggesting that ABS005 could offer a non-surgical treatment option for HPV-related cervical lesions, preserving cervical integrity and obstetric outcomes. The study's significance lies in its potential to inform future research on localized drug delivery for HPV-associated diseases. However, the evidence is limited to animal models, and the study does not include human clinical trials, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 宫颈上皮内瘤变 (CIN 2/3) 的治疗依赖于切除或消融手术,这些手术与宫颈狭窄、早产和流产率增加等并发症相关,并且不能解决潜在的 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染,从而导致持续存在和复发。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了 ABS005 在 宫颈癌 小鼠模型中的体内功效,其中 HPV 阳性 Tal3 肿瘤细胞被接种到 C57BL/6 小鼠胁腹中。它还表征了犬科动物宫颈内注射后 ABS005 的毒代动力学特征。
elements_zh.methods: 首先对 ABS005 的水凝胶特性和体外释放曲线进行了表征。为了评估体内功效,在 宫颈癌 的小鼠模型中评估了单个和多个 ABS005 治疗,并进行药代动力学分析以比较瘤内和全身药物分布。
elements_zh.main_results: ABS005 经配制可在 34°C (±2°C) 下固化成凝胶,并在体外提供超过 48 小时的持续药物释放,在体内提供至少一周的持续药物释放。在小鼠模型中,ABS005 的单个和多个 治疗 均成功阻止了肿瘤生长,并刺激了与咪喹莫特作用机制一致的瘤内免疫特征。药代动力学分析显示,咪喹莫特具有出色的局部滞留性,瘤内浓度超过全身水平 20,000 倍。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些数据表明 ABS005 可以提供咪喹莫特的持续、受控释放,以治疗 HPV 驱动的发育不良,同时保持良好的安全性。这种方法可以保留宫颈完整性和未来的产科结果,为女性提供非手术 治疗 选择。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 它可以为未来关于 HPV 相关 宫颈癌 局部药物输送的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于小鼠模型和犬毒代动力学分析,可能无法完全代表人类生理学。证据是中等的,因为这些发现是基于体外和动物研究,没有进行人体临床试验。

Absco Therapeutics has developed ABS005, a treatment for CIN2/3. ABS005 incorporates imiquimod, a TLR7 agonist used off-label for CIN2/3 with modest efficacy against both the lesion and HPV.6 However, topical formulations are limited by poor retention and washout.7 ABS005 is intended for direct intracervical injection, forming a depot for sustained, on-target imiquimod delivery. ABS005 is designed to eliminate CIN2/3 lesions and educate the immune system against HPV infection. This approach may preserve cervical integrity and future obstetric outcomes, providing women non-surgical treatment options.Methods The hydrogel properties and in vitro release profile of ABS005 were first characterized. To evaluate in vivo efficacy, single and multiple ABS005 treatments were assessed in a murine model of cervical cancer where HPV-positive Tal3 tumor cells are inoculated into C57BL/6 mouse flanks.8 9 Flow cytometry characterized the intratumoral response, profiling antigen presenting cells (CD80+ and 86+), dendritic cells (CD11c+), anti-tumor macrophage (F4/80+), cytotoxic T-cell (CD4+/CD8+) and NK-cell populations (CD45+/CD3-/CD49b+). Local-to-systemic therapeutic ratios were defined by comparing intratumoral and systemic drug pharmacokinetic profiles. Finally, we characterized the toxicokinetic profile of ABS005 following intracervical injection in canines.Results We formulated a polymer that solidifies into a gel at 34°C (±2°C) and provides sustained drug release over 48 hours in vitro and at least one week in vivo. In the murine model, both single and multiple treatments of ABS005 successfully halted tumor growth (figure 1) and stimulated an intratumoral immune profile consistent with imiquimod’s mechanism of action. Pharmacokinetic analysis revealed exceptional local retention, with intratumoral imiquimod concentrations exceeding systemic levels by 20,000-fold (figure 2). Furthermore, canine intracervical injections demonstrated that ABS005 was well tolerated, with a peak plasma Cmax of 19.4 ng/mL at 30 minutes post-treatment.Conclusions These data suggest that ABS005 can provide a sustained, controlled release of imiquimod to treat HPV-driven dysplasia while maintaining a favorable safety profile. Next steps include GMP-grade manufacturing, GLP toxicology, and FDA clearance of an investigational new drug application.Acknowledgements We appreciate Prof. Giovanni Traverso (MIT, Absco Therapeutics) and Prof. Avik Som (U Washington, Absco Therapeutics) for scientific discussions. The initial polymer delivery technology was developed at MIT Traverso Lab and Mass General Brigham.References World Health Organization. abstract_zh: 背景 宫颈上皮内瘤变 (CIN 2/3) 的治疗依赖于切除或消融手术。1 这些干预措施虽然有效,但与宫颈狭窄有关,2 会增加早产和流产率,3-5 并且不能解决潜在的 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染,从而导致持续存在和复发。Absco Therapeutics 开发了 ABS005,一种用于 CIN2/3 的 治疗。ABS005 含有咪喹莫特,这是一种用于 CIN2/3 标签外治疗的 TLR7 激动剂,对病变和 HPV 的疗效均有限。6 然而,局部制剂因保留性和冲洗性差而受到限制。7 ABS005 旨在用于直接宫颈内注射,形成持续、靶向咪喹莫特递送的储库。ABS005 旨在消除 CIN2/3 病变并教育免疫系统抵抗 HPV 感染。这种方法可以保留宫颈完整性和未来的产科结果,为女性提供非手术 治疗 选择。方法首先对 ABS005 的水凝胶特性和体外释放曲线进行了表征。为了评估体内功效,在 宫颈癌 小鼠模型中评估了单个和多个 ABS005 治疗,其中 HPV 阳性 Tal3 肿瘤细胞接种到 C57BL/6 小鼠胁腹中。8 9 流式细胞术表征肿瘤内反应,分析抗原呈递细胞(CD80+ 和 86+)、树突状细胞 (CD11c+)、抗肿瘤巨噬细胞(F4/80+)、细胞毒性 T 细胞 (CD4+/CD8+) 和 NK 细胞群 (CD45+/CD3-/CD49b+)。通过比较瘤内和全身药物药代动力学特征来确定局部治疗与全身治疗的比率。最后,我们对犬类宫颈内注射后 ABS005 的毒代动力学特征进行了表征。结果 我们配制了一种聚合物,该聚合物在 34°C (±2°C) 下固化成凝胶,并在体外提供超过 48 小时的持续药物释放,在体内提供至少一周的持续药物释放。在小鼠模型中,ABS005 的单个和多个 治疗 均成功阻止了肿瘤生长(图 1),并刺激了与咪喹莫特作用机制一致的瘤内免疫特征。药代动力学分析显示异常的局部滞留,瘤内咪喹莫特浓度超过全身水平 20,000 倍(图 2)。此外,犬宫颈内注射表明 ABS005 具有良好的耐受性,在 治疗 后 30 分钟时血浆 Cmax 峰值为 19.4 ng/mL。结论这些数据表明 ABS005 可以提供咪喹莫特的持续、受控释放,以治疗 HPV 驱动的发育不良,同时保持良好的安全性。下一步包括 GMP 级生产、GLP 毒理学以及 FDA 对新药研究申请的批准。致谢 我们感谢 Giovanni Traverso 教授(麻省理工学院,Absco Therapeutics)和 Avik Som 教授(华盛顿大学,Absco Therapeutics)进行的科学讨论。最初的聚合物输送技术是由麻省理工学院 Traverso analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 宫颈上皮内瘤变 (CIN 2/3) 的治疗依赖于切除或消融手术,这些手术与宫颈狭窄、早产和流产率增加等并发症相关,并且不能解决潜在的 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染,从而导致持续存在和复发。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了 ABS005 在 宫颈癌 小鼠模型中的体内功效,其中 HPV 阳性 Tal3 肿瘤细胞被接种到 C57BL/6 小鼠胁腹中。它还表征了犬科动物宫颈内注射后 ABS005 的毒代动力学特征。
analysis_zh.methods: 首先对 ABS005 的水凝胶特性和体外释放曲线进行了表征。为了评估体内功效,在 宫颈癌 的小鼠模型中评估了单个和多个 ABS005 治疗,并进行药代动力学分析以比较瘤内和全身药物分布。
analysis_zh.main_results: ABS005 经配制可在 34°C (±2°C) 下固化成凝胶,并在体外提供超过 48 小时的持续药物释放,在体内提供至少一周的持续药物释放。在小鼠模型中,ABS005 的单个和多个 治疗 均成功阻止了肿瘤生长,并刺激了与咪喹莫特作用机制一致的瘤内免疫特征。药代动力学分析显示,咪喹莫特具有出色的局部滞留性,瘤内浓度超过全身水平 20,000 倍。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些数据表明 ABS005 可以提供咪喹莫特的持续、受控释放,以治疗 HPV 驱动的发育不良,同时保持良好的安全性。这种方法可以保留宫颈完整性和未来的产科结果,为女性提供非手术 治疗 选择。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 它可以为未来关于 HPV 相关 宫颈癌 局部药物输送的研究提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于小鼠模型和犬毒代动力学分析,可能无法完全代表人类生理学。证据是中等的,因为这些发现是基于体外和动物研究,没有进行人体临床试验。

title: Plasmacytoid dendritic cells and M2 macrophages are associated with clinical outcomes in human papillomavirus–independent vulvar squamous cell carcinoma
abstract: Background Vulvar squamous cell carcinoma (VSCC) is a rare malignancy comprising HPV-associated (HPV-A) and HPV-independent (HPV-I) subtypes. HPV-I is associated with high recurrence rates and poor survival, yet lacks validated prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic stratification tools. Although immunotherapy has transformed cancer care and highlighted the tumor microenvironment (TME) as an important determinant of clinical outcome, the rarity of VSCC has limited its molecular characterization, and the TME remains poorly understood. We therefore aimed to define the VSCC TME in an HPV-specific context and identify immune features associated with clinical outcomes. Methods We analyzed 70 surgically treated VSCC (18 HPV-A and 52 HPV-I) using targeted transcriptomic profiling (HTG EdgeSeq). Immune and stromal cell composition was inferred by computational deconvolution, primarily with xCell and supported by EPIC, quanTIseq and MCPcounter. title: Anogenital Warts in an Elderly Male: Clinical and Public Health Perspectives
abstract: Abstract: Anogenital warts (AGWS), caused by human papillomavirus (HPV), are among the most common sexually transmitted infections (STIs). Although AGWS is more commonly found in younger adults, cases in older individuals are increasingly being reported. A 76-year-old man presented with progressively enlarging brown papules in the genital area (penile base, scrotum, and left inguinal fold). Histopathological examination showed epidermal hyperplasia, papillomatosis, acanthosis, and koilocytosis. PCR examination confirmed low-risk HPV types 6 and 11. The patient reported a history of multiple sexual partners, did not use condoms during sexual intercourse, and had limited knowledge regarding STIs transmission based on a questionnaire. The patient was treated with cryotherapy and lesion excision. At the final observation, complete lesion resolution was achieved with no new lesions observed. In conclusion, this case highlights the importance of maintaining clinical awareness of AGWs in older adults. Thorough diagnostic evaluation, sexual health education, regular STIs screening, and counseling should be integrated into routine care for the elderly population. Keywords: anogenital warts, human papillomavirus, elderly, sexually transmitted infections, STIs knowledge, public health

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on anogenital warts (AGWS), which are caused by human papillomavirus (HPV), and examines their occurrence in an elderly male population. The central question is the clinical and public health significance of AGWS in older adults, particularly in relation to sexual behavior, transmission knowledge, and treatment outcomes.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a single case study of a 76-year-old man with AGWS. The evidence includes clinical presentation, histopathological findings, PCR confirmation of HPV types 6 and 11, and patient-reported sexual behavior and knowledge. The methods used are descriptive and based on direct patient evaluation and diagnostic testing.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The case study confirms that AGWS can occur in elderly individuals, with PCR identifying low-risk HPV types 6 and 11. The patient's history of multiple sexual partners and lack of condom use is associated with the condition, and treatment with cryotherapy and lesion excision resulted in complete resolution. The review concludes that AGWS should be considered in older adults and emphasizes the need for clinical awareness.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review does not report controversies or conflicting findings. However, it highlights a potential evidence gap in understanding the prevalence and transmission dynamics of AGWS in elderly populations, as well as the effectiveness of preventive measures in this demographic.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests integrating thorough diagnostic evaluation, sexual health education, and regular STI screening into routine care for the elderly. It also implies the need for further research on the epidemiology and prevention of AGWS in older adults.

analysis.summary_en: This review presents a case study of a 76-year-old man with anogenital warts (AGWS) caused by human papillomavirus (HPV) types 6 and 11. The patient had a history of multiple sexual partners and did not use condoms, contributing to his risk of infection. Clinical and histopathological findings were consistent with AGWS, and treatment with cryotherapy and lesion excision led to complete resolution. The case underscores the importance of maintaining clinical awareness of AGWS in elderly individuals and integrating diagnostic evaluation, sexual health education, and STI screening into routine care. The review highlights the need for further research on the epidemiology and prevention of AGWS in older adults, as well as the role of HPV in this demographic.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述基于一名 76 岁 AGWS 男性的单一案例研究。证据包括临床表现、组织病理学结果、HPV 6 型和 11 型 PCR 确认以及患者报告的性行为和知识。所使用的方法是描述性的,并且基于直接的患者评估和诊断测试。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 案例研究证实 AGWS 可能发生在老年人中,PCR 鉴定出低危 HPV 6 型和 11 型。患者的多性伴侣史和缺乏安全套使用情况与该病有关,治疗 结合冷冻疗法和病变切除导致完全解决。审查得出的结论是,老年人应考虑 AGWS,并强调临床意识的必要性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查不报告争议或相互矛盾的发现。然而,它强调了在了解老年人群中 AGWS 的 患病率 和 传播 动态以及该人群中预防措施的有效性方面存在潜在的证据差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查建议将彻底的诊断评估、性健康教育和定期性传播感染筛查纳入老年人的日常护理中。这也意味着需要对 流行病学 和老年人 AGWS 的预防进行进一步研究。

title: Extended genotyping of human papillomavirus and AI-assisted cervical visual evaluation for prediction of cervical precancer in nine resource-limited settings (PAVE): a cross-sectional study
abstract: Background Effective cervical cancer screening in resource-limited settings requires accurate, scalable, and efficient approaches. We aimed to evaluate a novel cervical screening and triage strategy that combines self-sampled human papillomavirus (HPV) testing with AI-based automated visual evaluation (AVE) for the detection of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 3 or worse (CIN3+). Methods In this cross-sectional HPV-Automated Visual Evaluation (PAVE) study we designed a new cervical screening and triage strategy for resource-limited settings that integrated HPV hierarchical extended genotyping of self-collected vaginal specimens, AVE of women with HPV, and risk stratification for efficient health-care resource management. Between Nov 14, 2022, and June 5, 2025, non-pregnant women (aged 30–49 years or aged 25–49 years for women living with HIV [WLHIV]) with no previous cervical cancer were prospectively enrolled from clinical sites in Brazil, El Salvador, Honduras, the Dominican Republic, Cambodia, Eswatini, Malawi, Nigeria, and Tanzania. Self-collected vaginal samples were tested using a new, rapid, and simplified extended genotyping HPV assay that yields four oncogenic risk groups (HPV16 [highest risk]; HPV18 or 45 [high risk]; HPV31, 33, 35, 52, or 58 [moderate risk]; and HPV39, 51, 56, 59, or 68 [lowest risk]). Women with HPV had cervical imaging and biopsy to diagnose CIN3+, which was confirmed by expert telepathology. Cervical images were captured with a mobile colposcope and classified by a previously validated deep-learning AVE algorithm as severe, indeterminate, or normal. analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study evaluated a novel cervical screening strategy combining self-sampled HPV testing with AI-based visual evaluation (AVE) in nine resource-limited settings. The study aimed to assess the effectiveness of integrating HPV extended genotyping and AVE for detecting cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 3 or worse (CIN3+). title_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 的扩展基因分型和人工智能辅助宫颈视觉评估在九种资源有限环境中预测宫颈癌前病变 (PAVE):一项横断面研究
source_body_en: Background Effective cervical cancer screening in resource-limited settings requires accurate, scalable, and efficient approaches. We aimed to evaluate a novel cervical screening and triage strategy that combines self-sampled human papillomavirus (HPV) testing with AI-based automated visual evaluation (AVE) for the detection of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 3 or worse (CIN3+). Methods In this cross-sectional HPV-Automated Visual Evaluation (PAVE) study we designed a new cervical screening and triage strategy for resource-limited settings that integrated HPV hierarchical extended genotyping of self-collected vaginal specimens, AVE of women with HPV, and risk stratification for efficient health-care resource management. Between Nov 14, 2022, and June 5, 2025, non-pregnant women (aged 30–49 years or aged 25–49 years for women living with HIV [WLHIV]) with no previous cervical cancer were prospectively enrolled from clinical sites in Brazil, El Salvador, Honduras, the Dominican Republic, Cambodia, Eswatini, Malawi, Nigeria, and Tanzania. Self-collected vaginal samples were tested using a new, rapid, and simplified extended genotyping HPV assay that yields four oncogenic risk groups (HPV16 [highest risk]; HPV18 or 45 [high risk]; HPV31, 33, 35, 52, or 58 [moderate risk]; and HPV39, 51, 56, 59, or 68 [lowest risk]). Women with HPV had cervical imaging and biopsy to diagnose CIN3+, which was confirmed by expert telepathology. Cervical images were captured with a mobile colposcope and classified by a previously validated deep-learning AVE algorithm as severe, indeterminate, or normal. Absolute risks of CIN3+ and 95% CIs were computed within each stratum of the combined four HPV genotype groups and the three AVE categories by HIV status. Receiver operated analysis was computed to estimate area under the curve (AUC) for the strategy. Findings Among 49 074 women with valid HPV results, 13 992 (28·5%) were HPV positive, of whom 11 169 (79·8%) attended triage. Among 7535 women with HPV and complete AVE and pathology data, 359 (5·9%) CIN3+ cases were detected among 6113 HIV-negative women and 174 (12·2%) CIN3+ cases were detected among 1422 WLHIV. CIN3+ risk increased systematically across the hierarchical HPV and AVE categories, with the highest CIN3+ risk associated with HPV16 (19·6% [95% CI 17·3–21·9]; 221 of 1129 participants) and severe AVE classification (12·7% [11·5–14·0]; 366 of 2871 participants). Risk of CIN3+ assessed using HPV genotyping and AVE assessment supported the independent utility of the tests. HPV16 with severe AVE classification was detected in 162 (31·8% [95% CI 27·8–35·9]) CIN3+ cases among 509 women without HIV and 43 (42·6% [32·9–52·2]) CIN3+ cases were among 101 WLHIV. The maximum AUC was 0·82 (95% CI 0·80–0·84) for CIN3+ diagnosed with ectocervical biopsy. Interpretation Our findings support the efficacy of integrating self-sampling, HPV extended genotyping, and AVE as a cervical cancer risk prediction strategy. Cost-effectiveness analysis will be required before implementation. Funding NCI Cancer Cures Moonshot Initiative and Médecins Sans Frontiers Foundation.
abstract_zh: 背景 在资源有限的环境中进行有效的 宫颈癌 筛选需要准确、可扩展且高效的方法。我们的目的是评估一种新型宫颈筛查和分诊策略,该策略将自采样 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 检测与基于人工智能的自动视觉评估 (AVE) 相结合,用于检测 3 级或更严重的宫颈上皮内瘤变 (CIN3+)。方法 在这项横断面 HPV 自动视觉评估 (PAVE) 研究中,我们针对资源有限的环境设计了一种新的宫颈筛查和分诊策略,该策略整合了自采集阴道标本的 HPV 分级扩展基因分型、感染 HPV 女性的 AVE 以及用于有效医疗资源管理的风险分层。2022年11月14日至2025年6月5日期间,从巴西、萨尔瓦多、洪都拉斯、多米尼加共和国、柬埔寨、斯威士兰、马拉维、尼日利亚和坦桑尼亚的临床中心前瞻性招募了以前没有接受过宫颈癌的非孕妇(年龄为30-49岁,或感染艾滋病毒[WLHIV]的女性年龄为25-49岁)。使用新的、快速且简化的扩展基因分型 HPV 检测对自行收集的阴道样本进行测试,该检测可产生四个致癌风险组(HPV16 [最高风险];HPV18 或 45 [高风险];HPV31、33、35、52 或 58 [中等风险];以及 HPV39、51、56、59 或 68 [最低风险])。患有 HPV 的女性进行了宫颈成像和活检以诊断 CIN3+,并由专家远程病理学证实。使用移动阴道镜拍摄宫颈图像,并通过先前验证的深度学习 AVE 算法将其分类为严重、不确定或正常。根据 HIV 状态,在组合的四个 HPV 基因型组和三个 AVE 类别的每个层中计算 CIN3+ 和 95% CI 的绝对风险。计算接受者操作分析以估计该策略的曲线下面积 (AUC)。结果 在 49 074 名具有有效 HPV 结果的女性中,13 992 名 (28·5%) HPV 呈阳性,其中 11 169 名 (79·8%) 参加了分诊。在 7535 名患有 HPV 且具有完整 AVE 和病理数据的女性中,6113 名 HIV 阴性女性中检测到 359 例 (5·9%) CIN3+ 病例,在 1422 名 WLHIV 中检测到 174 例 (12·2%) CIN3+ 病例。CIN3+ 风险在 HPV 和 AVE 分级中系统性增加,其中最高的 CIN3+ 风险与 HPV16 相关(19·6% [95% CI 17·3–21·9];1129 名参与者中的 221 名)和严重 AVE 分类(​​12·7% [11·5–14·0];2871 名参与者中的 366 名)。使用 HPV 基因分型和 AVE 评估评估的 CIN3+ 风险支持了测试的独立效用。在 509 名未感染 HIV 的女性中,在 162 名 (31·8% [95% CI 27·8–35·9]) CIN3+ 病例中检测到具有严重 AVE 分类的 HPV16,在 101 名 WLHIV 中检测到 43 名 (42·6% [32·9–52·2]) CIN3+ 病例。对于通过宫颈外活检诊断的 CIN3+,最大 AUC 为 0·82 (95% CI 0·80–0·84)。解释 我们的研究结果支持整合自我采样、HPV 扩展基因分型和 AVE 作为 宫颈癌 风险预测策略的有效性。实施前需要进行成本效益分析。资助 NCI 癌症治愈登月计划和无国界医生基金会。

title: Implications of Alpha and Beta Human Papillomaviruses Infection in the Oral Microbiome from Mexican Subjects Living with HIV
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection and oral microbiota alterations have been independently associated with oral disease in people living with HIV (PLHIV). However, the relationship between alpha-HPV (α-HPV), beta-HPV (β-HPV), and the oral microbiome remains poorly understood. This cross-sectional study aimed to describe the association between oral HPV infection and the oral and oropharyngeal microbiome in Mexican PLHIV with sustained virologic control and immune reconstitution. Oral and oropharyngeal samples were obtained by rinsing and gargling, and participants were classified into HPV-negative, α-HPV (PGMY primers), and β-HPV (FAP primers) groups. The V3–V4 region of the 16S rRNA gene was sequenced using the Illumina MiSeq platform. A total of 65 participants were included in the final analysis: 19 HPV-negative, 16 -α-HPV positive (PGMY primers), and β-HPV positive (FAP primers). Bacterial Alpha diversity of the oral microbiome was significantly higher in both α-HPV- positive and β-HPV positive groups than in the HPV-negative group, with the highest diversity observed in the α-HPV positive group. The α-HPV group also showed a higher Fusobacteriota/Bacteroidota ratio and enrichment of Fusobacteriota-related taxa. In addition, predicted functional analysis showed enrichment of pathways related to lysine and pyruvate fermentation to butyrate in the α-HPV(PGMY primers) group. These findings suggest that α- and β-HPV infections may be associated with different oral microbial ecosystems in PLHIV.

source_records.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection and oral microbiota alterations have been independently associated with oral disease in people living with HIV (PLHIV). However, the relationship between alpha-HPV (α-HPV), beta-HPV (β-HPV), and the oral microbiome remains poorly understood. This cross-sectional study aimed to describe the association between oral HPV infection and the oral and oropharyngeal microbiome in Mexican PLHIV with sustained virologic control and immune reconstitution. Oral and oropharyngeal samples were obtained by rinsing and gargling, and participants were classified into HPV-negative, α-HPV (PGMY primers), and β-HPV (FAP primers) groups. The V3–V4 region of the 16S rRNA gene was sequenced using the Illumina MiSeq platform. A total of 65 participants were included in the final analysis: 19 HPV-negative, 16 -α-HPV positive (PGMY primers), and β-HPV positive (FAP primers). Bacterial Alpha diversity of the oral microbiome was significantly higher in both α-HPV- positive and β-HPV positive groups than in the HPV-negative group, with the highest diversity observed in the α-HPV positive group. The α-HPV group also showed a higher Fusobacteriota/Bacteroidota ratio and enrichment of Fusobacteriota-related taxa. In addition, predicted functional analysis showed enrichment of pathways related to lysine and pyruvate fermentation to butyrate in the α-HPV(PGMY primers) group. These findings suggest that α- and β-HPV infections may be associated with different oral microbial ecosystems in PLHIV.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the association between alpha-HPV and beta-HPV infections and the oral microbiome in Mexican people living with HIV (PLHIV) with sustained virologic control and immune reconstitution. The cross-sectional design involved collecting oral and oropharyngeal samples and classifying participants into HPV-negative, α-HPV positive, and β-HPV positive groups. The V3–V4 region of the 16S rRNA gene was sequenced using the Illumina MiSeq platform. Results showed that bacterial alpha diversity was significantly higher in both α-HPV and β-HPV positive groups compared to the HPV-negative group, with the highest diversity in the α-HPV group. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染和口腔微生物群改变与 HIV 感染者 (PLHIV) 的口腔疾病独立相关。α-HPV (α-HPV)、β-HPV (β-HPV) 和口腔微生物群之间的关系仍知之甚少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面研究旨在描述墨西哥 PLHIV 口腔 HPV 感染与口腔和口咽微生物群之间的关联,并持续病毒学控制和免疫重建。通过冲洗和漱口获得口腔和口咽样本,将参与者分为 HPV 阴性组、α-HPV(PGMY 引物)和 β-HPV(FAP 引物)组。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 Illumina MiSeq 平台对 16S rRNA 基因的 V3–V4 区域进行测序。最终分析共纳入 65 名参与者:19 名 HPV 阴性、16 名 -α-HPV 阳性(PGMY 引物)和 β-HPV 阳性(FAP 引物)。
elements_zh.main_results: α-HPV 阳性组和 β-HPV 阳性组口腔微生物组的细菌 Alpha 多样性均显着高于 HPV 阴性组,其中 α-HPV 阳性组的多样性最高。α-HPV 组还表现出较高的梭杆菌门/拟杆菌门比率以及梭杆菌门相关类群的富集。此外,预测的功能分析显示α-HPV(PGMY引物)组中与赖氨酸和丙酮酸发酵为丁酸相关的途径富集。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,α-和 β-HPV 感染可能与 PLHIV 中不同的口腔微生物生态系统有关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为未来关于特定 HPV 类型在改变 PLHIV 口腔微生物组中的作用的研究提供信息,从而可能有助于制定针对口腔健康的有针对性的干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是横断面的,限制了建立因果关系的能力。该证据基于口腔微生物组的测序和功能分析,这可能无法完全捕捉到 宿主 与病毒相互作用的复杂性。

title: Sex disparities and catch-up opportunities in self-reported human papillomavirus vaccination at a Midwestern University in the United States
abstract: Objective To assess sex disparities in self-reported human papillomavirus vaccination initiation and campus catch-up opportunities among undergraduates. Methods We analyzed baseline survey data collected February 23–March 13, 2023, from undergraduates aged 18–26 years at a public Midwestern university in the United States. The primary analysis included 115 students with known vaccination status; 50 with uncertain status were excluded. Modified Poisson regression estimated adjusted prevalence ratios. Sensitivity analyses assigned uncertain responses as unvaccinated or vaccinated. Results Among students with known status, 68 of 115 (59.1%) reported initiation. Male students had lower adjusted initiation prevalence than female students (adjusted prevalence ratio, 0.50; 95% confidence interval, 0.31–0.79). Estimates remained below 1.00 when all uncertain responses were assigned as unvaccinated (0.36; 0.21–0.61) or vaccinated (0.80; 0.64–0.99). Of 47 students reporting no vaccination, 57.4% expressed hypothetical willingness following healthcare professional advice and 48.9% if vaccination were offered on campus; corresponding proportions among 50 students with uncertain status were 62.0% and 52.0%. Conclusions Self-reported initiation was lower among male undergraduates across sensitivity scenarios. Record verification and prospective evaluation of recommendation and campus delivery are warranted.

abstract_zh: 目的 评估本科生自我报告的 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗接种 启动和校园追赶机会的性别差异。方法 我们分析了 2023 年 2 月 23 日至 3 月 13 日从美国中西部一所公立大学 18 至 26 岁本科生收集的基线调查数据。主要分析包括 115 名已知 疫苗接种 状态的学生;排除了 50 名身份不明的人。修正泊松回归估计调整后的 患病率 比率。敏感性分析将不确定的反应指定为未接种疫苗或接种疫苗。结果 在已知状况的学生中,115 名学生中有 68 名 (59.1%) 报告开始学习。男学生的调整起始 患病率 低于女学生(调整后 患病率 比率,0.50;95% 置信区间,0.31–0.79)。当所有不确定的反应被指定为未接种疫苗(0.36;0.21-0.61)或接种疫苗(0.80;0.64-0.99)时,估计值仍低于 1.00。在 47 名报告没有 疫苗接种 的学生中,57.4% 的学生表示假设愿意遵循医疗保健专业建议,而 48.9% 的学生表示愿意在校园内提供 疫苗接种;50名学生中,身份不明的相应比例分别为62.0%和52.0%。结论 在各种敏感性情景中,男大学生自我报告的开始程度较低。推荐和校园交付的记录验证和前瞻性评估是有必要的。

title: 621 Pelareorep and atezolizumab-induced expansion of HPV-16-specific T cells in the blood is associated with tumor responses in squamous cell anal cancer
abstract: Background Squamous cell anal cancer (SCAC) is a rare disease representing approximately 2.6% of GI cancers. Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the main cause of SCAC. Treatment options for ≥2L SCAC are limited. Checkpoint inhibitors (CPI) are recommended for immunotherapy naïve patients who failed 1L chemotherapy, but response rates are low. The oncolytic reovirus pelareorep (pela) combined with atezolizumab (atezo) has shown promise as a ≥2L treatment in this population. In pancreatic cancer patients treated with pela and atezo, tumor responses are associated with tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL) and mRAS clonal expansion in the blood. Here, we report the association between SCAC tumor responses, TIL infiltration, and HPV-16-specific clonal expansion in the blood. We also report post-therapy changes in the levels of plasma analytes that are associated with responses to checkpoint inhibitor therapyMethods A phase 1/2, Simon 2-stage study is being conducted to assess the safety and efficacy of pela in combination with atezo as a ≥2L therapy in patients with unresectable SCAC ( NCT07280377). Patients were treated IV with pela 4.5 x 1010 TCID50 weekly and atezo 840 mg biweekly on a 28-day cycle. Pre-treatment tumors were available from 4 patients to identify TILs by T-cell receptor sequencing (Adaptive Biotechnologies, Seattle, WA), and blood from these patients was analyzed for the expansion of TIL clones from baseline through 3 cycles. Blood from 14 patients was analyzed for HPV-16-specific clonal expansion by the Multiplexed Identification of T-cell Antigen Specificity assay (MIRA assay, Adaptive Biotechnologies). Plasma analytes including CXCL10, IFN-γ, and sPD-L1 were measured by the Olink assay in 8 patients after one cycle of therapy.Results Increases (> 2-fold) in CXCL10, IFN-γ, and sPD-L1 were observed in 7/8 subjects. TIL clonal expansion in the blood was observed after 3 cycles in all 4 patients and was associated with reductions in tumor size (2 complete and 2 partial responses per RECIST). These patients also showed a significant increase in at least one HPV-16-specific clone. Of the 14 patients evaluated, 6 had HPV-16 clonal expansion, and 4 of these showed a reduction in tumor size.Conclusions Pela + atezo can achieve favorable tumor responses in ≥2 nd-line SCAC. These responses are associated with HPV-16-specific and TIL clonal expansion in the blood. The favorable changes in plasma analyte levels were also associated with the immune control of tumors. Together, these data support further evaluation of pela and CPI as an immunotherapy for SCAC.

title: Human Papillomavirus Prevalence in Seminal Tract Among the Patients with Testicular Tumor; Dose HPV Infection Have an Etiological Role for the Development of Testicular Tumor?
abstract: This study investigated the prevalence, genotypes, and tissue localization of human papillomavirus (HPV)-DNA in testicular tumor including epididymis and spermatic cord specimens from 116 Japanese patients who underwent radical inguinal orchiectomy. Formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissues were analyzed by nested polymerase chain reaction (PCR), followed by sequencing-based HPV genotyping. HPV-DNA localization was assessed by in situ hybridization (ISH), and E6/E7 mRNA ISH was performed in HPV-positive specimens. HPV-DNA was detected in three patients (3/116, 2.6%), including one testicular tumor specimen (1/116, 0.9%) and two spermatic cord specimens (2/116, 1.7%). All HPV-positive specimens contained HPV16-DNA. HPV-DNA ISH signals were observed in seminoma cells in one testicular specimen and in the vas deferens epithelium in one spermatic cord specimen. On the other hand, ISH signals were not present in epididymis tissue in the HPV-positive testicular tumor tissue, suggesting that HPV-DNA detection rate of epididymis was 0%. E6/E7 mRNA signals were not detected in any HPV-positive specimen. These findings demonstrate that HPV16-DNA was surely present in testicular tumor and the vas deferens epithelium. However we could not provide evidence of transcriptionally active HPV oncogenes, and could not establish a causal role in testicular tumorigenesis.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate whether human papillomavirus (HPV) infection could play an etiological role in the development of testicular tumors. The background highlights the need to understand the potential association between HPV and testicular cancer, which is not typically linked to HPV.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted on 116 Japanese patients who underwent radical inguinal orchiectomy, analyzing testicular tumor, epididymis, and spermatic cord specimens to assess HPV prevalence and tissue localization.
analysis.methods: Formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissues were analyzed using nested polymerase chain reaction (PCR) for HPV-DNA detection, followed by sequencing-based HPV genotyping. HPV-DNA localization was further assessed by in situ hybridization (ISH), with E6/E7 mRNA ISH performed on HPV-positive specimens.
analysis.main_results: HPV-DNA was detected in three patients (3/116, 2.6%), including one testicular tumor specimen (1/116, 0.9%) and two spermatic cord specimens (2/116, 1.7%). All HPV-positive specimens contained HPV16-DNA.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that HPV16-DNA is present in testicular tumor and spermatic cord tissues, but they do not provide evidence of transcriptionally active HPV oncogenes or a causal role in testicular tumorigenesis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform future studies on the potential role of HPV in testicular cancer, though they do not establish a direct link to disease causation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study could not provide evidence of transcriptionally active HPV oncogenes, limiting the ability to establish a causal role. The evidence is moderate as it only shows presence of HPV16-DNA without functional confirmation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the prevalence of human papillomavirus (HPV) in testicular tumor and spermatic cord specimens from 116 Japanese patients. HPV-DNA was detected in three patients, with all positive specimens containing HPV16-DNA. The presence of HPV16-DNA in tumor and vas deferens epithelium was confirmed through in situ hybridization. However, the study could not establish a causal role for HPV in testicular tumorigenesis due to the absence of transcriptionally active oncogenes. These findings suggest a potential association between HPV16 and testicular cancer but do not confirm etiological involvement. The evidence is moderate, as it only demonstrates the presence of HPV16-DNA without further functional analysis.

elements_zh.main_results: HPV-DNA was detected in three patients (3/116, 2.6%), including one testicular tumor specimen (1/116, 0.9%) and two spermatic cord specimens (2/116, 1.7%). All HPV-positive specimens contained HPV16-DNA.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,HPV16-DNA 存在于睾丸肿瘤和精索组织中,但它们没有提供转录活性 HPV 癌基因或在睾丸肿瘤发生中的因果作用的证据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能为未来关于 HPV 在睾丸癌中的潜在作用的研究提供信息,尽管它们并未建立与疾病因果关系的直接联系。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究无法提供具有转录活性的 HPV 癌基因的证据,限制了确定因果关系的能力。证据是中等的,因为它仅显示 HPV16-DNA 的存在,而没有功能确认。

title: Anatomical Distribution of Human Papillomavirus Infection in the Lower Urinary Tract of Men with Bladder Cancer Undergoing Radical Cystectomy
abstract: We investigated the anatomical distribution of human papillomavirus (HPV) infection in the lower urinary tract of men with bladder cancer undergoing radical cystectomy. In total, 79 anterior urethral samples, 99 prostatic urethral specimens, 74 bladder tumor specimens, and 87 non-tumor bladder specimens were collected from 102 patients. After DNA extraction from each formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue specimen, HPV-DNA was examined by nested polymerase chain reaction, and HPV genotypes were determined by Sanger sequencing. In situ hybridization (ISH) was used to localize HPV-DNA in positive samples, and E6/E7 mRNA ISH was performed to assess transcriptional activity. HPV-DNA was detected at any site in 16 (15.7%) of 102 patients, with site-specific detection rates of 8.0% (7/87) in non-tumor bladder mucosa, 5.1% (4/79) in the anterior urethra, 4.1% (3/74) in bladder tumor tissue, and 4.0% (4/99) in the prostatic urethra. HPV16 was detected in 11 samples, and HPV18 in 7 samples. HPV-DNA ISH signals were observed in 12 (66.7%) of 18 HPV-positive specimens, and E6/E7 mRNA signals were present in 2 of 18 specimens. HPV-DNA was detected at various sites of the lower urinary tract. E6/E7 mRNA expression in a bladder cancer specimen warrants further research on the biological relevance of HR-HPV infection.

After DNA extraction from each formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue specimen, HPV-DNA was examined by nested polymerase chain reaction, and HPV genotypes were determined by Sanger sequencing. In situ hybridization (ISH) was used to localize HPV-DNA in positive samples, and E6/E7 mRNA ISH was performed to assess transcriptional activity. HPV-DNA was detected at any site in 16 (15.7%) of 102 patients, with site-specific detection rates of 8.0% (7/87) in non-tumor bladder mucosa, 5.1% (4/79) in the anterior urethra, 4.1% (3/74) in bladder tumor tissue, and 4.0% (4/99) in the prostatic urethra. HPV16 was detected in 11 samples, and HPV18 in 7 samples. HPV-DNA ISH signals were observed in 12 (66.7%) of 18 HPV-positive specimens, and E6/E7 mRNA signals were present in 2 of 18 specimens. HPV-DNA was detected at various sites of the lower urinary tract. E6/E7 mRNA expression in a bladder cancer specimen warrants further research on the biological relevance of HR-HPV infection.

title: Human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell-derived small extracellular vesicles delivering CERS1 promote squamous differentiation in HPV16-positive cervical intraepithelial neoplasia via remodeling sphingomyelin metabolism
abstract: Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN), a precursor of human papillomavirus (HPV)-driven cervical cancer, poses a severe threat to women’s health. High-risk HPV infection drives CIN progression, whereas well-defined intervention targets and effective non-invasive therapies remain lacking. Herein, Using New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), specifically HPV16-positive ectocervical organoids as a human-relevant disease model, we evaluated the therapeutic potential of engineered cell-free small extracellular vesicles derived from human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells (hucMSC-sEV). We found that hucMSC-sEV significantly promoted squamous differentiation in S12 cells and HPV16-positive ectocervical organoids. Mechanistically, integrated multi-omics analyses within this NAMs platform revealed that hucMSC-sEV delivered ceramide synthase 1 (CERS1) to upregulate C18 ceramide (C18 Cer) synthesis, activating the non-canonical p53 signaling to drive squamous differentiation. In NCG mice bearing subcutaneous xenografts of S12 cells, hucMSC-sEV effectively inhibited S12 xenograft growth and modulated squamous differentiation via regulation of C18 ceramide metabolism, while this therapeutic effect was abrogated in CERS1-knockdown hucMSC-sEV. This study delineates the molecular mechanism by which hucMSC-sEV remodel sphingolipid metabolism to promote cervical squamous epithelial differentiation and suppress S12 xenograft development, providing novel potential targets and therapeutic strategies for CIN intervention.
